description: Runs `tgcloud login` with a CLI access token (app<id>:<secret> from @BotFather → your bot → Serverless → CLI Access → Access token). This is NOT the Bot API token (123456:AA…). The CLI wants a TTY, so the token is written to stdin with TGCLOUD_ASSUME_TTY=1 and masked in every tool result. NEVER show the token to the user after this call. In CI, set TGCLOUD_TOKEN and skip login.

project_dir.description: Absolute path to a tgcloud project directory (contains .tgcloud/)

token.description: CLI access token from @BotFather (Serverless → CLI Access), form app<id>:<secret>

name: login_bot
title: Link a bot to the project
